propositions: Four workflows (test.yml, optionality.yml, prompt-eval.yml, verify-identity.yml) must exclude the tickets branch from push-triggered CI by adding 'tickets' to their branches-ignore lists.
A new enumerating test must validate that no workflow file in .github/workflows/ matches a push to the tickets branch, and fail if a future workflow adds a bare 'push:' trigger.

Adopter documentation must warn that CI watching all branches will fire on every store write, since the store auto-pushes the tickets branch on every comment/edit/claim/close; the canonical guidance goes in docs/concurrency.md with cross-links in docs/user-guide.md and docs/config.md.

All schedule blocks and their cron expressions (reconcile-bridge */20 * * * *, verify-identity 53 */6 * * *, test 41 */6 * * *, optionality 47 */6 * * *, prompt-eval weekly 0 7 * * 1) must remain byte-identical and unchanged by the branch-filter addition.
gerrit-verify.yaml must remain workflow_dispatch-only and not be modified.
Push CI for ordinary topic branches (e.g., wip-some-topic) must continue to trigger all four edited workflows after the change.
